_comment: Workbook exercise air-static-pressure (docs/workbook/air-static-pressure.md), ornl-frp-vav part: the VAV damper census over the ten boxes of the default subset's fault-free day (d3_fault_free, a Thursday) -- one air handler's zones on one day, not the stuck-damper days, where the box under test would skew the census. `camber datasets config ornl-frp-vav --exercise air-static-pressure--ornl-frp-vav --store DIR --out cfg.json` fills in the store path. damper_census takes each box's median damper opening over occupied hours (each box's own trended occupancy, the tests' 07:00-22:00 every day, since 0.98; the assumed weekday 07-18 schedule only for a box with none trended) and calls static too high when most boxes throttle below 50 % open, too low when a quarter or more sit at 90 % or above -- the rule's default bands, not tuned. The RTU's duct static is trended but its setpoint is not (the tests fix it at 249 Pa, descriptor Methods), so static_pressure_reset is not run.
